title: Compare two PDFs page by page through pdfxi compare
acceptance: cargo test -p pdfxi-cli passes; pdfxi compare aligns real revision pages by content, reports aligned/changed/inserted/deleted rows with line detail, exits 1 on --fail-on-difference, and VIEW-015 moves to verified.
notes: LCS page alignment over normalised page text with a replacement-block pass, line-level change counts, two-column --lines output capped at 20 rows, stable JSON and an optional non-zero exit for scripts.
